question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           date_trunc('month', payment_date) as month,
           SUM(amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           month,
           monthly_total,
           LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as prev_month_total
    FROM monthly_totals
),
changes AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           monthly_total - prev_month_total as monthly_change
    FROM with_prev
    WHERE prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
),
avg_changes AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           AVG(monthly_change) as avg_monthly_change
    FROM changes
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, ac.avg_monthly_change
FROM avg_changes ac
JOIN customer c ON ac.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY ac.avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1
